title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Mount Assembly — Install the Stiffened Heat Shield and the Shouldered Forward Link
abstract: Installs the stiffened auxiliary power unit mount heat shield with its additional standoffs and replaces the forward mount link with the shouldered variant and a controlled preload fastener.

sections.planning_reason: Heat shield distortion around the forward mount link was found on twenty-three aircraft, with fastener torque relaxation on two of them. The shield as delivered is unsupported over four hundred millimetres directly above the exhaust duct and deflects onto the link during a long ground run, which is where the fastener load comes from. Left alone the condition produces a repeat finding at every compartment inspection and, on the worst aircraft, an unscheduled link replacement.
sections.description: This bulletin installs the stiffened heat shield with two additional standoffs picking up existing holes in the mount frame, and replaces the forward mount link with the shouldered variant that carries the standoff load directly. The link fastener is replaced by the controlled preload type. The mount geometry is unchanged, so no re-rigging of the auxiliary power unit is required.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the auxiliary power unit compartment access and put the safety barriers in position. Record the as-found shield distortion at the three positions and the forward link fastener torque, and enter both on the reply form. Remove the existing heat shield and the forward mount link. Install the shouldered link with the controlled preload fastener and tighten in the sequence and to the preload given in the bulletin. Install the stiffened shield with the two additional standoffs and check the clearance to the exhaust duct at four points. Do the mount installation task in AMM-M-49-10-12-000-041-A to confirm the shroud fit, run the auxiliary power unit for twenty minutes and re-check the clearances hot. Close the compartment and update the parts catalogue effectivity record.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00028 and M00310. Aircraft that accomplished the inspection bulletin MRD-49-1011 may credit those measurements against the first two steps.
sections.material_note: Kit contains the stiffened shield, two standoffs, the shouldered link and the controlled preload fastener set. The removed link is returned for metallurgical sampling within thirty days. Shield lead time is fourteen weeks.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 48 months of the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next auxiliary power unit compartment inspection, whichever occurs first.
